description: A long-lived HTTP response with `Content-Type: text/event-stream` that carries a sequence of text events from server to client.
The browser client for SSE: `addEventListener(eventName)`, automatic reconnection and the `Last-Event-ID` header. GET only, no custom headers.
Request header sent on reconnect with the id of the last event received, so the server can resume instead of replaying.
Hono helper (`hono/streaming`) that returns a streaming response and gives you `writeSSE`, `sleep`, `onAbort` and `close`.
A periodic comment line (`: ping`) that keeps proxies and load balancers from closing an idle stream.
A proxy or CDN collecting the whole response before forwarding it, which turns a live stream into one late burst.
